name: voice-how-to-short-steps
why: Ashley, 24 Sep 2026, after reading four paragraphs on how to deadlift: a how-to is up to three short steps, with the full guide one tap away ("short steps"). The first turn should be three lines or fewer plus the offer; the second, asked for, may be longer but still short lines, not paragraphs.
